messages:
Alyssa (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to lock partner alignment for the SDK breaking change (v3 -> v4). Goal: single announcement window + staggered rollout per partner constraints. Thoughts? :wave:
Mike (platform): Which partners are in the critical path? do we have non-negotiable requirements (e.g., signed SLAs) or long lead times? :eyes:
Alyssa (partnerships): Critical path list: CloudMarket (marketplace listing & approval, needs 6w notice), HWCo (onboarded device vendors, require signed SLA + test harness, ~8w), SI-Delta (large integrator wants a beta SDK + docs, ~4w), SI-Echo (managed service partner, 3w). Also two smaller ISVs that can be bundled into the 4w slot.
Jordan (eng): Proposal: offer a compatibility flag (SDK.compat_mode = "v3") for 12 weeks and a marketplace shim package for partners that can't upgrade immediately. Canaries: HWCo week-1, CloudMarket limited listing in week-2, full listing week-6.
Sanjay (devex): We can produce a partner-preview build (tag: partner-preview/2026-05) and a small migration guide. Telemetry gating: opt-in telemetry + compat telemetry stream so we can measure errors per partner. Sample version map snippet:
```
# simplified compatibility matrix
{"sdk_version": "4.0.0", "compat_flag": "v3", "shim_package": "marketplace-shim-0.9", "support_window": "12w"}
```
Mike (platform): Need a clear rollback path if we see regressions from SI-Delta. Also confirm whether the marketplace listing can carry a shim (legal?) — @legal to verify but we should assume we can for now.
Alyssa (partnerships): Good call. Also need joint-announcement cadence: internal embargo -> partner preview -> joint blog + marketplace banner -> public docs update. Target dates (tentative): preview -> 2026-05-05, soft announce partners -> 2026-05-12, public -> 2026-06-16. :calendar:
Jordan (eng): Can we automate a compatibility test harness that partners can run prior to preview? I can put together a small test suite that runs on CI and reports pass/fail. Will need sample payloads from SI-Delta.
Sanjay (devex): I'll own the preview SDK build and the migration guide. Plan: publish to private registry + add opt-in telemetry flag and a small CLI check command: `ri-compat-check --target v4`.
Mike (platform): I'll coordinate release windows and schedule the canaries. Putting a hold on major infra changes during the 3-week canary window. release-bot: Release window reserved: preview 2026-05-05 -> canary 2026-05-05..2026-05-26 -> general 2026-06-16.
Alyssa (partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Alyssa: finalize partner comms + embargo text by 2026-04-20. 2) Jordan: test-harness + CI checks by 2026-04-28. 3) Sanjay: partner-preview SDK + migration guide by 2026-04-30. 4) Mike: canary schedule + infra freeze notice by 2026-04-25. 5) @legal: confirm marketplace shim/legal by 2026-04-22. Please react with :thumbsup: if assigned and add any blockers.
Mike (platform): :thumbsup: I'm on it.
Jordan (eng): :thumbsup: need SI-Delta payloads.
Sanjay (devex): :thumbsup: will publish registry link once build ready.
Alyssa (partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll DM partner PMs and start comms thread. If anything lands, post here so we have a single source of truth. :loudspeaker:
